payload.message:
Generate and publish today's Prompt Pack for aibusinessinsider.org. 1. PICK TOPIC: python C:\Users\compj\.openclaw\workspace\scripts\content-nova\prompt_pack_gen.py --site aibusinessinsider.org Returns JSON with 'topic' and writing instructions. State at scripts/content-nova/prompt-pack-state.json tracks 30-day no-repeat. 2. WRITE PROMPTS: Following the 'instructions' string from step 1, write exactly 3 highly refined prompts on the topic. Output JSON: { "title": "Daily Prompt Pack: - ", "excerpt": "", "intro_html": "

1-2 sentence intro with a hook and the topic line.

", "prompts": [ {"tag": "[Claude]", "body": ""}, {"tag": "[ChatGPT]", "body": ""}, {"tag": "[Cursor]", "body": ""} ], "footer_html": "

Full archive at aibusinessinsider.org/tag/prompt-pack.

} Rules: under 80 words per prompt, tool-tagged bracket prefix, force specificity, deliver one tangible artifact. 3. HUMANIZE WRAPPER COPY (NOT the prompts): The 3 prompts are the product and MUST stay verbatim - Opus rule, no exceptions, 100% accuracy required. Apply the humanizer skill (skills/humanizer/SKILL.md) to: - title (rewrite in natural voice, drop AI tells) - excerpt (same) - intro_html (same) - footer_html (same) Do NOT touch the prompts[].body fields. The cross-poster also runs a mechanical pass on social captions. 4. PUBLISH + CROSS-POST in one call: python C:\Users\compj\.openclaw\workspace\scripts\content-nova\prompt_pack_orchestrator.py --site aibusinessinsider.org --content-json '' NOTE: aibusinessinsider.org is Cloudflare-403 blocked. The orchestrator detects this and queues drafts to memory/prompt-pack-social-drafts/ without publishing live. Let it fail soft. If the WP draft creation fails due to 403, just save the content_json to memory/prompt-pack-social-drafts/aibusinessinsider-org-.json and report the blocker. Do not retry endlessly. 5. Deliver a summary to #wordpress: post URL or blocker status, topic, and any cross-post failures (drafts saved). DO NOT manually post anything outside the orchestrator script. DO NOT modify the prompts[].body fields during humanization.
